shareholding.remarks_web: Please note that Adani Commodities LLP and Lence Pte. Ltd. have been classified as Promoters of the company in the shareholding pattern filed with exchanges till 30.09.2025. On 19.11.2025, Adani Commodities LLP had sold 168,958, 219 equity shares representing 13% of the issued and paid up share capital of the Company to Lence Pte. Ltd., another promoter entity of the Company by way of an off market transfer. The Company has given disclosure to the exchanges on 19.11.2025 under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. Subsequently on 21.11.2025, Adani Commodities LLP sold 90,977,502 equity shares representing 7% of the issued and paid up share capital of the Company by way of bulk deal mechanism on the floor of the stock exchanges. Adani Commodities LLP has given disclosure to the exchanges and to the company under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI SAST Regulations of this sale of shares. By virtue of the above transactions, the shareholding of Adani Commodities LLP in the Company has been reduced to 0. (Nil).The Company received a request dated 21.11.2025 from Adani Commodities LLP and other entities for re-classification from promoter to public. Consequently the Company has made application to the stock exchanges for re-classification of Adani Commodities LLP, Adani Enterprises Limited and other entities as promoters on 27.11.2025. The exchanges (BSE and NSE) have given their No Objection for reclassification of Adani Commodities LLP, Adani Enterprises Limited and other entities as Promoter/Promoter Group vide their letters dated 6th March 2026. Hence in the shareholding pattern filed for the quarter ended 31st March 2026, none of these entities have been included as Promoter/ Promoter Group.
Promoter Group does not include subsidiaries of AWL Agri Business Limited (formerly known as Adani Wilmar Limited).

Gautam Shantilal Adani, Rajesh Shantilal Adani and Vinod Shantilal Adani are the trustees of S.B. Adani Family Trust which holds more than 10% in Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL). AEL holds 99.99% in Adani Commodities LLP, which is one of the promoters of the Company holding 30.42% stake in the Company. In terms of significant beneficial interests received by the Company from respective promoter companies, Gautam Shantilal Adani, Rajesh Shantilal Adani and Vinod Shantilal Adani are identified as significant beneficial owners and indirectly collectively hold 30.42% stake in the Company.  In SBO, as there is option to mention PAN of one SBO, hence we have mentioned PAN of Gautam Shantilal Adani. Further, in case of nationality, we have mentioned Indian/ Cypriot as nationality of (i) Gautam Shantilal Adani and Rajesh Shantilal Adani is Indian,  and (ii) nationality of Vinod Shantilal Adani is Cypriot.
